summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a routine monthly determination of net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026, approval of new offering prices for its private placement, declaration of monthly distributions, and a summary of recent investment activity. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, shareholder activism, restructuring, or other special situation event is reported. The filing is an ordinary current report updating shareholders on NAV, pricing, and distributions.
